Process

How we'll work together

A simple, predictable pipeline — the same one behind the published work above. You always know what stage your video is at.

STEP 01

Send your footage

Message me on LinkedIn with a link to your raw files — Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, whatever you already use. Add any references or notes you have; rough is fine.

Any platformFree sample first
STEP 02

The edit

I cut for the story first: structure, pacing, hooks. Then the craft layer — motion graphics, kinetic type, sound design, captions, color — and AI b-roll only where it serves the cut.

Premiere · AE · DaVinciAI pipeline
STEP 03

Review & refine

You watch a review cut and send notes — a timestamp list is perfect. I revise until it matches the brief; long-form work goes through the same multi-round QC my channel clients use.

Review cutRevision rounds
STEP 04

Publish-ready delivery

Final files arrive in the exact formats your platform wants — vertical, square or widescreen, captioned and loudness-checked — with project files archived in your Playbook library.

All aspect ratiosProject files kept

About

The editor behind the cuts

I'm Mohammadreza Jafari — Reza. I started in journalism: press, news agencies and TV documentary. That training never left the edit bay. Every cut I make answers the reporter's questions first — what happens, why it matters, why keep watching.

For the past 10+ years I've edited commercially as a remote contractor and freelancer: true-crime series for US YouTube channels, brand campaigns and product ads, podcasts, and short-form content — including a personal film that passed a million views on Instagram.

My edge is the combination: classical storytelling craft plus an AI-accelerated pipeline. Generative tools handle the heavy lifting — b-roll, scenes, sound — so turnaround stays fast without the work ever looking synthetic.

Based in Istanbul, working with clients worldwide. Happy to start with a free sample edit on your footage.

FAQ

Questions, answered straight

The things clients usually ask before the first project. Anything else — ask me on LinkedIn.

What kinds of videos do you edit?+

Short-form for Instagram, TikTok and Shorts; full podcast episodes and their clips; brand commercials and product films; and true-crime / documentary long-form for YouTube. If it tells a story, it is in my wheelhouse — my background is journalism and TV documentary.

How do I send you my footage?+

Any way you already share files: a Google Drive, Dropbox or WeTransfer link sent to me on LinkedIn is enough. Scripts, brand assets and reference videos are welcome but not required — rough material is fine, structuring it is my job.

Can I judge the work before committing?+

Yes — new projects start with a free sample edit on your own footage. You see exactly how I would cut your material before we agree on anything bigger.

How do revisions work?+

You receive a review cut, send your notes (a simple timestamp list works best), and I refine from there. It is the same loop I run with YouTube production teams, where episodes pass several QC rounds before publishing — nothing ships until it is right.

What do I receive at delivery?+

Publish-ready files in the formats your platform needs — vertical, square or widescreen — captioned and loudness-checked. Project files and assets stay archived in your Playbook library, so future edits can pick up exactly where we left off.

Do you work with AI tools? Will my video look artificial?+

I use Runway, Kling, Luma, Midjourney, Higgsfield and Suno for b-roll, scenes and sound where they genuinely help — always blended into real footage and finished by hand in Premiere Pro, After Effects and DaVinci Resolve. The goal is invisible assistance, never a synthetic look.

Which languages and time zones do you cover?+

I edit English- and Persian-language content and work remotely from Istanbul with clients worldwide — including US-based production teams running on their own schedules.

Have footage?
Let's cut something people finish.

Send me a message on LinkedIn with a link to your raw footage — I'll come back with honest notes and, if it's a fit, a free sample edit. The full portfolio library, including project files and more samples, lives on Playbook.
